decisions.reason: It fits the firm's stated push into compliance and agency-focused tools, and after surviving two years on its own page it looks cheap enough to keep open while demand continues to reveal itself.
As the homepage flagship and core platform direction, it is strategically central and the firm is very unlikely to withdraw it within a year.
This offering sits close to the core hosting business and has remained visible for two years, so the firm would likely keep it unless it is later folded into broader packaging.

It serves real agency demand for legacy projects and is still too new to judge fully, but its ongoing security and support burden makes it the most plausible candidate for withdrawal if uptake disappoints.
